name: Scrying
description:
Casting time: 1 minutes. Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

You attempt to observe a creature from afar. Roll Awareness vs Awareness against any creature you can name. If you have never seen the creature before, your roll is ill-favored. If you have seen and spoken to the creature, your roll is favored. Either way, the creature senses your presence in this moment (though not your identity), and may choose to lose the check voluntarily if it wants to be observed.

On a win, you can see and hear the creature as if you were located within short range of it. If the creature moves, your point of view moves with the creature, always remaining within short range of it.

On a loss, no effect, and you can’t use this spell against the same creature again for 1 day.

Instead of targeting a creature, you can choose a location you have seen before as the target of this spell. When you do, you observe from a point of view at that location (no roll required) and it doesn’t move.

Describe your scrying method.
successes:
✨: On a win, you may sustain the effect for 10 additional minutes.

🌞: On a win, you may sustain the effect for up to 1 hour. Additionally, while observing, you may spend an action to move your point of view in any direction you choose (if you do this while observing a creature, the point of view no longer automatically follows the creature). On a loss, you know the direction and distance of the creature from you.
